scope: Spanish top flight (Primera División / La Liga), 1929 onward
source: Wikipedia season articles (YYYY–YY La Liga) league tables, cross-check

fieldNotes.footsimuId: ESPN team id (the id FootSimu uses)
fieldNotes.footsimuPath: club page path under the league the club plays in now (2026-27), without locale
fieldNotes.points: final points after deductions (2 points per win until 1994-95, 3 from 1995-96)
fieldNotes.name: club name as shown in the source list for that season (Wikipedia uses period names for Madrid FC and Atlético Aviación; other clubs appear under their modern short name)
